label_rules.ASSERT_SUPPORT: Publisher or source actor endorses frozen full proposition, with explicit qualifiers retained.
label_rules.ASSERT_REFUTE: Publisher explicitly rejects frozen proposition; quoted rejected claims do not create MIXED.
label_rules.ATTRIBUTED_ONLY: Full frozen proposition attributed to speaker without unambiguous publisher adoption of all essential scope.
label_rules.MIXED: Unresolved claim-relative competing commitments; not merely a quote followed by a decisive verdict.
label_rules.NOT_ADDRESSED: Inspected representation has no full-claim commitment; related partial subclaims may remain.
label_rules.null: Unavailable/uninspected/missing body; never silently converted to NOT_ADDRESSED.
